headline: Wall Street falls sharply ahead of Nvidia's quarterly results
summary: US stocks fell sharply as investors awaited Nvidia's quarterly figures, with the AI chipmaker's results also seen ahead of an anticipated Anthropic stock market listing.
why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips, so its earnings are a key read on demand for AI infrastructure and on broader tech-sector sentiment.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Shares are falling as investors wait for the company's quarterly results.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors are reducing positions ahead of Nvidia's results, which are a closely watched gauge of AI demand. The anticipated Anthropic listing adds to attention on AI valuations.
original_headline: Wall Street cae con fuerza a la espera de los resultados trimestrales de Nvidia
